description: Curated index of Maya's currently implemented agent tools.

tools.name: app_open
tools.description: Launch a known desktop application or open a file/URL through xdg-open.
tools.whenToUse: Use for native applications or default file handlers rather than browser automation.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click a page element by visible text or accessible name and optional ARIA role.
tools.whenToUse: Use for accessible pages where the target can be named reliably.

tools.name: browser_click_selector
tools.description: Click a page element by CSS selector and optional match index.
tools.whenToUse: Use when accessible-name clicking fails, especially in complex SPAs.

tools.name: browser_eval
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the current page and return a JSON-serialized result.
tools.whenToUse: Use as an advanced fallback to inspect or interact with a page when structured tools fail.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the persistent Playwright page and return its title and ARIA snapshot.
tools.whenToUse: Use when an agent must open a URL and immediately inspect structured page content.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a keyboard key in the active Playwright page.
tools.whenToUse: Use for browser keyboard interactions not covered by type-and-submit.

tools.name: browser_read
tools.description: Read the current Playwright page as a bounded ARIA accessibility snapshot.
tools.whenToUse: Use before interacting with a simple page or to inspect page state without a screenshot.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the visible Playwright page and return an image through MCP.
tools.whenToUse: Use when an agent needs a visual capture of the current browser page.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page or a CSS-selected container by direction and optional pixel amount.
tools.whenToUse: Use to reveal content or move within a scrollable page/container.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Fill a field by label, placeholder, or accessible name and optionally submit it.
tools.whenToUse: Use for ordinary form filling when the field has an accessible label.

tools.name: browser_type_selector
tools.description: Fill an input or contenteditable element by CSS selector and optionally submit it.
tools.whenToUse: Use for SPA forms or contenteditable fields that accessible locators cannot fill.

tools.name: clipboard_read
tools.description: Read text from the Wayland clipboard through wl-paste.
tools.whenToUse: Use when the user's current copied text is relevant.

tools.name: clipboard_write
tools.description: Write text to the Wayland clipboard through wl-copy.
tools.whenToUse: Use to make generated text available for the user to paste.

tools.name: file_delete
tools.description: Move one file into Maya's trash so it can be undone.
tools.whenToUse: Use for reversible deletion of a single file, not directories.

tools.name: file_read
tools.description: Read a text file by absolute or home-relative path with bounded output.
tools.whenToUse: Use to read a known local text file through Maya.

tools.name: file_write
tools.description: Create or overwrite a text file, snapshotting overwritten content for undo.
tools.whenToUse: Use to create or deliberately replace a local text file.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Return the active window title and class using compositor-specific backends.
tools.whenToUse: Use to identify what application/window the user is focused on.

tools.name: listen
tools.description: Wait for a spoken command through Maya's current microphone adapter.
tools.whenToUse: Use in the MCP voice loop to receive the user's next spoken command.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Remove one persistent Maya memory fact by ID.
tools.whenToUse: Use when a persisted fact is outdated or should no longer be retained.

tools.name: memory_save
tools.description: Add or update one persistent Maya memory fact.
tools.whenToUse: Use to preserve a short user preference or project fact across conversations.

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Show an immediate desktop notification through notify-send.
tools.whenToUse: Use to surface a non-voice result or heads-up immediately.

tools.name: proc_list
tools.description: List background processes managed by the current Maya server session.
tools.whenToUse: Use to find process IDs and current managed-process status.

tools.name: proc_logs
tools.description: Return trailing output from a managed background process log.
tools.whenToUse: Use to inspect a managed dev server, watcher, or background task.

tools.name: proc_start
tools.description: Start a long-running command in Maya's session process manager.
tools.whenToUse: Use for dev servers, watchers, or other commands that must outlive one tool call.

tools.name: proc_stop
tools.description: Stop a managed background process with SIGTERM or optional SIGKILL.
tools.whenToUse: Use to terminate a process started through Maya's process manager.

tools.name: remind
tools.description: Persist a notification or spoken reminder for a relative or absolute time.
tools.whenToUse: Use when Maya must surface something later, including after an MCP restart.

tools.name: reminder_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one pending reminder by ID.
tools.whenToUse: Use after reminders_list when a scheduled reminder should not fire.

tools.name: reminders_list
tools.description: List pending reminders in soonest-first order.
tools.whenToUse: Use to inspect pending reminders and retrieve cancellation IDs.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current desktop using an available Linux screenshot backend.
tools.whenToUse: Use when an agent needs a visual capture of the user's full desktop.

tools.name: shell_run
tools.description: Run a one-shot shell command with a 30-second timeout and bounded output.
tools.whenToUse: Use for focused commands that complete quickly; use proc_start for long-running work.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Speak text through Maya's configured TTS backend.
tools.whenToUse: Use in the MCP voice loop to reply aloud.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Reverse the most recent reversible file delete or overwrite.
tools.whenToUse: Use after an incorrect Maya file overwrite or trash operation.

tools.name: vault_append
tools.description: Append Markdown to an Obsidian note, creating it when absent.
tools.whenToUse: Use to safely add information without replacing existing note content.

tools.name: vault_read
tools.description: Read an Obsidian note by title through the ob CLI.
tools.whenToUse: Use when the exact Obsidian note title is known.

tools.name: vault_search
tools.description: Search the configured Obsidian vault by query through the ob CLI.
tools.whenToUse: Use when the note title is unknown or information may span notes.

tools.name: vault_write
tools.description: Replace the complete content of an Obsidian note.
tools.whenToUse: Use only when full note replacement is intentional.

tools.name: voice_ask
tools.description: Ask a free-form spoken question when a voiceAsk dependency is available.
tools.whenToUse: Use in legacy daemon/live paths that inject voiceAsk; the MCP server uses listen and speak instead.
